files.summary: SiteDocument represents a link between Site and Document entities in the system. Primarily, it is a simple model with fields for ID and SiteID, used to associate documents with a specific site.
files.purpose: To tie documents to sites in the system, enabling document storage and retrieval based on site context.
system_behavior: SiteDocument serves as a join or link between sites and documents.

files.summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a user interface for staff, featuring controls for login details, error/warning panels, date filtering, site and discipline selection, and a grid displaying employment applications. It supports paging, filtering, and validation.
files.purpose: Provides a welcome dashboard and filtering interface for staff administrators to view and manage employment applications and related data.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering
steps: Select site from ddSite dropdown.
Select discipline from ddDiscipline dropdown.
Enter start and end date for filtering.
Click cmdRefreshView to update the grid.
GridView displays employment applications.

business_rules: RequiredFieldValidator ensures date fields are filled.
CustomValidator (checkStartEnd) ensures start date is not after end date.
Paging and filtering supported in application grid.
validations: Start date must be before or equal to end date.
system_behavior: User session determines visible sites and disciplines.
Error/warning panels auto-hide via client script.
GridView supports paging and displays formatted rows.

files.summary: ServiceCode represents a code used for categorizing services in the application. ServiceCodes contain fields such as CodeCategoryID, ShortName, Name, SortOrder, Notes, and alternate language fields.
files.purpose: Categorize and store information about service codes used in various parts of the system, supporting multilingual display.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Retrieval
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all codes.
Localize fields if alternate language is enabled.
Return list of ServiceCode entities.

business_rules: If alternate language fields are enabled, use NameAlt and NotesAlt instead of Name and Notes.
system_behavior: ServiceCodes can be retrieved by course ID, timetable ID, or as a complete list.
Fields localized based on session language mode.

files.summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks edit actions made to Site profiles, including who made the change, the section, fields, and agency context. It supports alternate languages and displays formatted user details.
files.purpose: To provide an audit trail of profile changes for sites, including user details, action date, affected fields, and agency.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistory Search
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
System returns a list of history entries.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is set, ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields are displayed in alternate language.
system_behavior: User actions and changes are logged with audit details.
User formatting adjusts based on role and agency.

files.summary: EmailPopupDocument is an entity representing an email-related document with fields for an ID, FileName, FilePath, and Checked status. The workflow supports searching, deleting files and folders linked to emails.
files.purpose: Used for managing email-related documents in the system, including searching and deletion.

workflows.name: Email Document Deletion
steps: Split DataInfo string into individual emails.
Find entry by ID.
Delete the file and folder if they exist.

workflows.name: Email Document Search
steps: Split DataInfo string into individual emails.
Create EmailPopupDocument entries with ID, FileName, FilePath.

system_behavior: Files and folders associated with emails are deleted when called.
Search creates a list of document entities from input.

files.summary: ExpenseBatch is a financial entity representing a batch of expenses tied to a department with fields for date, description, status, and closed date. Supports CRUD operations with validation and audit.
files.purpose: Track and manage batches of financial expenses for departments, including creation, update, deletion, and status tracking.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch Search
steps: Call Search with session and department ID.
Return batches for the department in the last year.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch CRUD
steps: Add: Call Add with session, department ID, description, date.
Update: Call Update with session, batch attributes.
Delete: Call Delete with session and batch ID.

business_rules: StatusDescription uses alternate language field if enabled.
system_behavior: BatchNumberFormatted combines ID and status description.
